entries.text:
# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

Oelitigiits, O NISGAM, Gil gísiitepotjit gisi nenolin a gepmitelmolim. Oelimito, enge asma, nin mnagötim ag Gil migogötim, nineolegagiim ag Gil mihotim. Me eimog niloei Nisgam pasig. Gíl tan Apognimaasti metoegiötog ag Gil Iaptijoei.
